data.name: Inner West Suburbs We Cover | Inner West Sydney Plumbers
data.description: Plumbers covering every Inner West suburb, from Balmain and Rozelle to Marrickville, Burwood, Strathfield and Concord. Find your suburb, then call 0412 395 426.

acceptedAnswer.text: If your suburb is on this page, yes. We cover all of the Inner West, City of Canada Bay, Burwood and Strathfield council areas. If you are just outside them, call and tell us your street, and we will tell you straight away whether we can get to you.

mainEntity.name: Why does my suburb not have its own page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Suburb pages are written for the larger suburbs where there is enough local detail to be useful. Smaller suburbs are covered by the same team and the same plumbers, and the paragraph about your neighbourhood above shows which suburb page is closest to you.

mainEntity.name: You mention Burwood, Croydon and Camperdown. Are those the Sydney ones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Several Inner West suburbs share a name with suburbs in Melbourne, including Burwood, Croydon and Camperdown. We are a Sydney business and only work in the New South Wales suburbs on this page.

mainEntity.name: Which council looks after the drain in my street?

acceptedAnswer.text: The council for your suburb looks after the street drains and gutters. The table above shows which of the four councils covers each suburb. Pipes inside your property boundary, including stormwater out to the kerb, are the owner's responsibility.

mainEntity.name: Do you work after hours in every suburb?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our phone is answered 24 hours, and emergency calls are attended across the whole area at night and on weekends. After-hours work costs more than a weekday booking, and we tell you the price before we start.

mainEntity.name: Do you work on apartment buildings and businesses in every suburb?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work for home owners, landlords, strata managers and business owners right across the area, from walk-up blocks in Ashfield to towers in Rhodes, and from King Street cafes to Marrickville workshops.
